pairs.evidence: src/lib/types/frontendTypes.ts:239 The persisted shape of a Lab result (labTestMetadata) carries one averaged composite score of tool accuracy, output quality and protocol compliance, plus a single recommended model, with no trial count, aggregation rule, variance or metric roles. That makes a composite the quality verdict that is shown and fed back into persona building, which is exactly what metric-role-contract forbids.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/types/frontendTypes.ts:239 One averaged composite stands in for metrics with different roles. The type has no slot for an optimized metric versus threshold constraints.
src/lib/types/frontendTypes.ts:240 A winner is stored with no margin, N or resolution evidence. The producer (labFeedbackLoop.ts, outside this context) picks the highest average.
src/lib/types/frontendTypes.ts:238 The contract has coverage and an average but no trials-per-cell and no declared aggregation rule (pass^k vs pass@k), so the score travels without its predicate.
src/lib/types/frontendTypes.ts:241 Weaknesses are scenario/metric/score triples only. Nothing records how a failure failed.
